n83-s2-legacy-coarse.scope: One fresh legacy coarse control; no independent repeated phase calibration.

summary.scope: Two reversed bare repeats are a prototype screen, not statistical confidence. Require >=0.10 s/step in BOTH pairs. PMU includes MPI progress/spinning; no per-symbol causal savings claim. All numerical/placement gates must pass. Memory counters and sampling are deliberately omitted.

source_identity: All seven recorded source inventories and build logs match frozen Stage203 kit; executable hashes match every run record; payload binaries/checkpoints are not included in review archive.

n83-s2-baseline-coarse.scope: Ordinary-step rank envelopes include MPI progress/waiting. Maxima in different phases need not belong to the same rank and must not be summed as a critical path.

numerical_scope: Archived 16-field comparator reports rechecked against exact/fixed-legacy policy. Checkpoint payloads are absent, so payload comparisons are not rerun.
decision: Do not promote as the accepted next performance baseline: both pairs miss the predeclared 0.10 s/step threshold. Preserve prototype and evidence; Stage202 remains accepted baseline.
